artworks.title: Owasco Lake, Casowasco
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a tranquil landscape from an elevated vantage point. A house with a tower is surrounded by trees and vegetation, with a fence and railway track visible nearby. A calm body of water is present, along with hills and farmland in the distance. The sky is overcast with thick clouds, and the overall tone of the image is sepia.

artworks.title: South Bethlehem General Office Buildings
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows two large buildings set against a sloping landscape. The horizon is obscured by the elevated ground behind the buildings. The buildings have multiple stories, rows of windows with awnings, chimneys, and decorative cornices. The railroad tracks run horizontally at the bottom of the image. The color tone is sepia, giving an antique quality. The color palette is predominantly brown. The sky is clear with no visible clouds. Trees on the left provide a touch of greenery.

artworks.title: Coal Piers and Harbor, North Fair Haven
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of train tracks extending into the distance. There are large structures, including a grain elevator with angular roofs and sheds, on the left side near the tracks. Sparse vegetation is visible beyond the structures. In the distance along the tracks, the top masts of a ship are visible. Parallel tracks are on the right side, alongside material piles and wooden frameworks. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving the image an aged look. No figures are present, creating a quiet atmosphere emphasizing the architectural and industrial elements.

artworks.title: Glen Summit Hotel
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a set of train tracks running diagonally from the lower left corner to the center right edge, leading toward a large building. In the foreground, the tracks and a raised wooden platform dominate, suggesting a functional space. The horizon aligns with the roofline of the building, slightly elevated on a grassy hill. Trees dot the slope leading to the building, contrasting against the windows and architectural detailing. The image has a vintage, sepia-toned palette, giving it an aged appearance. Additional structures and trees are visible in the distance, fading into the background as the landscape extends away.

artworks.title: A House, West Humble Lane, Norbury, Surrey
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic cottage with a chimney, set slightly off-center to the right. The sky is faint and undefined. The painting has delicate brushstrokes, likely created with a watercolor technique. The color palette includes earthy tones of brown, gray, and hints of green from foliage. A wooden fence frames the left side, with blurred trees and bushes in the background.

artworks.title: The Mocking of Christ
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on two joined pieces of blue paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image displays a drawing of several figures. Three full-length figures are prominently featured in the foreground. On the left, a bearded man is shown wearing a headband and garment, raising his arms and holding a crown of thorns in his right hand. The central figure is hooded and cloaked, facing away from the viewer with a slightly bowed head. To the right, another figure with indistinct facial features holds an object near their head, dressed in flowing, layered fabrics. The figures are depicted in various positions suggesting motion or interaction, without facing the viewer directly. The drawing is sketched with detailed yet slightly rough lines on a light blue background, focusing on the figures with minimal detail in the background.

artworks.title: A Rocky Seacoast in a Storm
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache and gum arabic on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a rugged coastline with a rocky shore on the right. The sea and sky have a grey-blue hue, suggesting a stormy or overcast atmosphere. Waves are crashing against the rocks. A ship with a tilted mast is partially submerged in the water. The brushstrokes are delicate and soft, creating a misty effect. The color palette includes muted grays, blues, and earthy browns. The sky is cloudy, adding to the foreboding atmosphere.

artworks.title: Moustachioed Slav in Belgrade
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is an upper body portrait of a man facing forward. He has a stern expression, high cheekbones, and a prominent mustache. He wears a red fez hat with a blue tassel, a gold-embroidered waistcoat over a white shirt, and a cloak over his shoulders. The background is neutral.

artworks.title: Saint Francis Receiving the Stigmata
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Jimmy and Jessica Younger, Houston
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a natural setting among trees, rocks, and plants. The figure on the right is standing with their full body visible, looking upward with both arms raised towards a radiant light emanating from an angelic figure above them in the sky. This person appears to have a short beard and hair, and wears a monk's robe cinched at the waist. The second figure is seated on the left side, gazing up in the same direction with a hand shielding their eyes. They also wear a similar robe and hold a set of large beads or rosary in their left hand. The background features a landscape with trees and a distant building or estate beneath a dramatic sky filled with clouds and rays of light. The detailed engraving captures both figures within a rocky outcrop, with the foreground complemented by leafy branches and small blooming flowers.

artworks.title: The Spies Returning from Canaan
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with blue wash over black chalk, squared for transfer with red chalk, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring figures, clouds, and trees. The sketch includes winged figures amongst clouds in the upper part of the composition. On the ground, figures are interacting, with some gesturing. Two individuals carry a large cluster of grapes. The setting includes foliage and a distant landscape. Red grid lines cover the drawing, suggesting preparatory work. Blue shading emphasizes specific sections.

artworks.title: A Cascade in the Mountains
artworks.medium: watercolor over pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diane A. Nixon
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall flowing between rocky cliffs from an elevated angle. The top of the waterfall is visible, and brushstrokes convey the movement of the water. The color palette includes blues, purples, greens, and warm tones, creating a contrast.

artworks.title: Studies for the Virgin and Child (recto)
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a series of sketches on textured, blue-toned paper featuring studies of figures. Each drawing displays full-body poses of seated or reclining figures with emphasis on draped clothing. The sketches depict figures facing various directions with diverse angles and positions, showing heads bowed or slightly turned without detailed facial features or specific hairstyles. The artist used chiaroscuro effects with pencil for depth and shade, giving the figures a three-dimensional appearance. There are no additional objects or jewelry around the figures, and the plain background only shows the paper's texture and slight pencil smudges. A red number "72" is faintly visible in the top left corner.

artworks.title: Battle by a River
artworks.medium: pen with brown and black ink and gray wash
artworks.description: This is a painting of a battle scene set in a dramatic landscape. The image shows foot soldiers and cavalry clashing amidst smoke from muskets and cannons on rugged terrain. The foreground is filled with soldiers in combat, some aiming rifles and others engaged in close combat. Horses and riders are also depicted, some charging bravely while others are falling. The scene extends to a river, where soldiers and animals are navigating the water. The sky is filled with dramatic clouds and sunlight, adding urgency and drama to the image. The style is reminiscent of Jacques-Louis David, known for historical and neoclassical motifs.

artworks.title: Allegory of Winter with Diana the Huntress
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological or fantastical figures and scenes. The imagery presents a group of figures and fantastical beings pouring out liquids from jars. These figures are perched upon clouds or elevated platforms amidst a dynamic landscape. The lines are intricately detailed, showcasing patterns etched to give texture to fabrics and natural elements like clouds. The drawing depicts symbols of the zodiac, highlighted by icons such as an aquatic figure likely representing Aquarius. The composition is energetic, with swirling motions and expressive postures emphasized by flowing garments and interactions among the figures.

artworks.title: Old Gérard, Peasant from Chasselay
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man sitting down, facing slightly to his left. His hands are resting on a hat in his lap. The man has long, wavy hair and is wearing a buttoned shirt. The background is a dark, flat color.

artworks.title: Soir (Evening)
artworks.medium: etching and stipple etching on laid paper
artworks.description: Three people are depicted indoors. On the left, a man with short curly hair is seated closely beside a woman with curly hair. The woman wears a light, striped dress. An older woman is seated nearby, engrossed in an activity. The setting includes a spinning wheel, stone walls, a hearth, cooking utensils, a dog, a staircase, and items on shelves.

artworks.title: La Nuit (Night)
artworks.medium: etching and stipple etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying in bed, hugging two striped pillows. They are on their side, with a peaceful expression. The room has a bed, curtains, a stool with a spotted cushion, a small dog, a side table with a vase, a basket, wooden beams, a decorative shelf with flowers and a scroll, and hanging artwork. The lighting indicates nighttime.

artworks.title: Lorina and Alice Liddell in Chinese Dress
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund, Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund, The Ahmanson Foundation, and New Century Fund
artworks.description: Two young girls with shoulder-length, dark hair wear Chinese, mandarin-style tunics in this nearly square black and white photograph. Both appear to have pale skin. They have short, rounded noses and dark eyes, and their lips are closed. One girl sits with her legs tucked under her on an upholstered armchair as she looks steadily out at us. The other, to our left, stands and leans onto one elbow, which is propped on the back of the chair. She reaches her other arm across her body to rest her hands near each other. Her hair falls in long, defined curls. She also wears a mandarin-style tunic and wide-legged pants. She rests one foot up on a block partially tucked under the chair, so her knees are together. She looks down and off to our right. Both tunics are decorated with long-necked birds and plants. The girls wear conical-shaped hats, each with a small white ball at the top. A wide parasol with closely spaced ribs is open behind the pair. The space behind them appears to be draped with cloth, and a plant in a pot sits to the left.

artworks.title: Fisherman from Marken
artworks.medium: drypoint on tan Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person seated on a wooden bench indoors. The individual is in a relaxed pose with hands in lap and legs spread. They have a serious expression with strong cheekbones and wear a hat, a long-sleeved top with buttons, and baggy pants. The room features wooden paneling and shelves with circular objects resembling jars or barrels.

artworks.title: The Duomo in Milan from a Side Street
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over black chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a street leading towards a grand cathedral. The Milan Cathedral is prominently featured in the background with its intricate spires piercing the sky. From a lower viewpoint, the cathedral looms impressively over the scene. Buildings on the left and right of the street frame the view, showcasing a mix of architectural styles with detailed facades. In the foreground, there is a bustling street scene with people dressed in 19th-century clothing. The color palette includes rich earthy tones in the buildings and attire, contrasting with the blue sky. The precise brushwork captures textures and architectural details, creating a realistic urban setting. Sunlight casts sharp shadows, adding depth to the image.

artworks.title: John Paul Jones, Commodore au Service des Etats Unis de l'Amérique (John Paul Jones, Commodore in the Service of the United States of America)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features an upper-body illustration of a person. The individual is positioned slightly turned to their left. They are facing outward towards the viewer. The subject appears to be male and is wearing a tricorn hat, which is a classic naval hat, and a tailored double-breasted coat, typical of the 18th-century naval attire. His facial features include a slightly upturned nose and a stern expression. The textures of his long hair extend from beneath the hat. Surrounding the individual are naval elements, such as ropes and masts. The setting appears to be on a ship, with the presence of smoke or clouds suggesting a possible battle. The background is filled with rigging and sails, reinforcing the nautical theme. The illustration is framed in a patterned border, resembling an inset within the larger beige-toned paper sheet. Beneath the image, there is text in French providing a description related to the person's military rank and historic significance.

artworks.title: William Penn's Treaty with the Indians
artworks.medium: engraving and etching with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 42.7 × 59.1 cm (16 13/16 × 23 1/4 in.)
sheet: 48.9 × 60.9 cm (19 1/4 × 24 in.) (cut within platemark)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a historical scene depicting a treaty between European settlers and Native Americans. The scene shows a gathering of European settlers dressed in period clothing, engaging in a diplomatic interaction with a group of Native Americans adorned in traditional attire and headdresses. The environment is outdoors with large trees framing the left side, and several European-style buildings in the background. Beyond the buildings, there are ships visible in the distance, indicating a coastal setting. The sky is full of clouds, providing a dramatic backdrop. The painting includes detailed clothing textures and expressions conveying negotiation and discussion. This is in the style of Benjamin West.

artworks.title: Nudes Dancing around a Shadow
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in black on Japan paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the gift of Nelson Blitz, Jr. and Catherine Woodard in Honor of Perri and Allison Blitz

artworks.title: Mascarade Chinoise faite a Rome (Chinese Masquerade)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Vincent J. Buonanno
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene in a city, with a ceremonial procession. The perspective is frontal, showing a view of the scene. Buildings on both sides dominate the composition. The scene includes detailed buildings, a large column, and structures in the background. The sky has clouds and fine line work for texture. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray and detailed crosshatching. The parade shows participants in elaborate costumes, some on horseback and others pulling a carriage.
